worldcombat.skill.surf.summary: Heaves one full ring of water outward from underfoot: every foe in the ring takes a surge, is shoved outward and soaked; burning foes are doused with their burns and ground fires are quenched. Rising tide trades reach for a taller, harder wave; sheet tide spreads wider and faster.
worldcombat.skill.surf.use.0: Swamp every foe standing around you at once
worldcombat.skill.surf.use.1: Shove a close surround outward and soak it
worldcombat.skill.surf.use.2: Douse burning foes and ground fires
worldcombat.skill.surf.use.3: Heave from rain or water for a stronger wave
worldcombat.skill.surf.description.0: Each target in the ring takes about %1$s damage; the target's special defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.surf.description.1: The wall reaches %1$s blocks and stands %2$s blocks tall - targets no higher than the crest are caught too.
worldcombat.skill.surf.description.2: Push the target outward %1$s blocks and soak it for %2$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.surf.description.3: The crest takes %1$s s to travel from underfoot to the rim, throwing up about %2$s droplets on the way.
worldcombat.skill.surf.description.4: Each cast sweeps the ground and quenches about %1$s open fires.
worldcombat.skill.surf.tide.on: Rising tide: power about x1.14, a x1.3 taller crest, x1.25 more shove and a longer soak, but the wall narrows to x0.82 with wind-up +3 and cooldown +10.
worldcombat.skill.surf.tide.off: Sheet tide: the wall spreads x1.15 wider and comes out faster (cooldown -4), at about x0.9 power.
worldcombat.skill.surf.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.surf.growth.0: At level %1$s the surge rises to %2$s, the wall reaches %3$s blocks and the crest rises to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.surf.preference.tide.h: On (rising tide): power about x1.14, a x1.3 taller crest, x1.25 more shove and a longer soak, but the wall narrows to x0.82 with wind-up +3 and cooldown +10 - for hammering one or two priority targets. Off (sheet tide): the wall spreads x1.15 wider and is faster, good for covering a crowd.
worldcombat.skill.surf.preference.ai.max: The companion only considers Surf when a threat is this close; lower it to heave only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
worldcombat.skill.surf.preference.ai.min: At least this many visible, living targets must stand inside the wall before it heaves; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to heave at a single target.
